notes:
Primary contact: Elena Varga (CTO).
Snapshot: early-stage private VPC procurement for inference stack — heavy security and residency constraints.
Use-case detail: customer-facing chat + backend reranking and high-volume embeddings for personalization.
Performance targets: chat p95 <150ms, tail <200ms; sustained throughput target ~300 req/s chat (burst to 600), embeddings bulk ~1000 req/s offline. Cost sensitivity: medium-high (financial ops team will validate TCO).
Data residency / compliance: strict EU-only for PII & transaction logs. Quote from CTO: "No east-west data egress outside EU — must remain on EU accounts only." Must satisfy GDPR + internal audit (7 year retention for audit logs).
KMS & keys: customer requires CMKs in their AWS account, HSM-backed (CloudHSM) preferred; Redwood must support import-to-KMS flow and key rotation policy. Need detailed KMS integration doc and example CloudFormation/Terraform template.
Audit logging: full request/response metadata (no raw PII) forwarded to Splunk instance via secure collector; must support log signing and retention controls. Also want optional sample-level redaction options.
VPC topology / networking notes:
- Desired topology: inference instances in private subnets in customer's account; Redwood control plane only allowed outbound connectivity via customer-managed egress (no inbound public endpoints).
- Proposed connectivity options discussed: Transit Gateway with cross-account attachments OR VPC Peering + AWS PrivateLink for control-plane RPCs. Customer preference: Transit Gateway + PrivateLink for health/metrics.
- Inbound/outbound: they want zero inbound allowed from internet. Routing: outbound NAT for package updates/model pulls limited to specific S3 endpoints via VPC endpoints.
- Health checks & control-plane: customer requires mTLS between Redwood agent and control plane over an outbound-only IPsec tunnel or PrivateLink; cannot accept plain TLS over public internet.
- Regions: primary EU-West-1 (Ireland), DR EU-Central-1 (Frankfurt). APAC traffic will be routed to hosted API for non-PII flows; any APAC user PII must be masked before processing.
POC scope & acceptance criteria: 2-week POC. Objectives: validate p95 latency, KV-cache hit rate, tokenization parity vs their tests, throughput at target QPS, KMS-encrypted checkpoint storage, and log forwarding to Splunk. Success = pass latency targets + proof of KMS integration + signed security checklist.
